# Lockheed Martin Investor Day 2025

October 7, 2025

## 21st Century Security

Our strategy connects platforms, sensors and effectors across domains for the U.S. and allied customers.

## Multi-year financial framework (as presented October 7, 2025)

- Target: mid-single-digit sales growth through 2027, driven by Missiles and Fire Control and Space.
- Target: segment operating margin of approximately 11% by 2027.
- Target: free cash flow of at least $7.0 billion in 2026 and growing in 2027.
- Capacity: PAC-3 MSE production of 650 interceptors in 2027 and 750 per year by 2028; GMLRS of 14,000 rockets per year in 2027.
- Capital expenditures of approximately $2.0 billion per year in 2026 and 2027 to fund munitions capacity expansion.
- Capital deployment: return substantially all free cash flow to shareholders through dividends and repurchases.

## Growth drivers

- F-35 sustainment and Lot 20-21 production.
- International demand for integrated air and missile defense.
- Hypersonics and the Next Generation Interceptor.
